pages.title: Personal playlists
pages.text: Your saved playlists are available at any speaker you can control. Browsing or editing another list leaves playback running. Each network keeps its own playback copy.

pages.title: Playlist playback
pages.text: Playing a list starts at its beginning; playing an entry starts there. Both preserve queued requests. Requests play once, then the playlist resumes at its remembered position.

pages.title: Limits and deletion
pages.text: Save up to 16 lists, 256 entries per list and 512 total. Names must be unique, 1–64 characters. All lists can be deleted; deleting the playing source stops it but keeps requests.
